scope: Pre-run development study. Keep the verified d501807 release bundle sealed. No released validation/test, course unseen task or model API is used. User authorized a larger total local fitting allowance.
question: Separate the effect of more total fitting opportunities from the effect of actively collecting decision-relevant evidence. Exploration, corroboration, deployment and early stopping remain available to the agent in every arm.
data: Reuse exactly the four prior development training packets, held features, score declarations, fixed train/held rows, and sealed 9-fit passive outputs. Reproduce the n17 passive9 sentinel from scratch. Use the same installed encoders, candidate factory, scoring, model refit rules, Python, 18643 training seed and 600 s per path. All arms start in separate empty directories with no stdin or network.

independent_check.generator: sklearn make_classification, 1000 rows, 16 columns, 8 informative, 3 redundant, 3 classes, 2 clusters/class, weights [0.57,0.29,0.14], class_sep 1.1, flip_y 0.09, seed 941227, other sklearn defaults

intervention: While a proposal awaits two distinct later exploration observations, score the information in each admissible new experiment by the absolute disagreement between prospective parent and child predictions, capped by observed mean absolute parent forecast error. Divide by the physical experiment cost and number of missing observations. Credit only if the budget can finish the missing comparisons, preserve the incumbent refit, and still afford a subsequent useful training action. Where an admissible confirmation exists, preserve space for one such confirmation. No quotas or forced actions; stop/confirm/explore contend on the same general evidence-based scale. Freeze the promotion test and generation cap at their original values.
comparisons: passive16 minus passive9 for the budget effect
active9 minus passive9 to test evidence allocation at the original budget
active16 minus passive16 to test evidence allocation at the new budget
active16 minus active9 to measure budget with active allocation
active16 minus passive9 for the combined change
independent active16 minus passive16 on n83
endpoints: per-task declared primary metric, matched individual gains/losses
number of proposals completed, adopted and left waiting
actual physical fits in exploration, confirmations and final refits; early exits allowed
changed actions due to evidence gathering versus using a promoted rule
first divergent moves and whether both exploration and confirmation actually occurred
fresh-process prediction identity and source/split/row fingerprints
evaluation: Freeze all new models and prediction files before scoring any new outputs. Previously opened development outcomes are historical. No outer score enters the controller or changes this protocol. Compare only on the same input and declared metric; equally weight the four development score differences and report the new task separately.
replication_gate: Consider a scheduling variant for a wider replication only for mean high-budget active-minus-passive gain at least 0.005 on the four development panels, improvement on at least two, no loss exceeding 0.02, at least one changed actual action and nonnegative new-task difference. Report wider-budget standalone and evidence-collection endpoints independently. No automatic replacement of the released submission.

spending.budget_breakdown: Four panels x (9+16+16)=164, one 9-fit reproduction=9 and one new panel x (16+16)=32. All include component and final refits. Paired experiments are separate runs.
